$comment: Single source of truth for browser persistence. Checked by scripts/storage-schema-audit.js (run by npm run validate:production) and tests/storage. See docs/storage-schema-validation.md.

entries.retention: Kept until the form is submitted or the draft is discarded.
entries.cleanup: Removed by clearAllStorage() on logout, account change and 401, and by the form on submit.
entries.description: Non-secret in-progress form values keyed by form id.

entries.retention: Kept until the user resets it; browser-scoped.
entries.cleanup: Removed by clearAllStorage(); invalid or unknown-version values are discarded on read.
entries.description: Reduced-motion and high-contrast choices. app/layout.tsx reads it in a pre-hydration inline script and never writes it.

entries.retention: 7 days from last save (expiresAt on each draft).
entries.cleanup: Expired drafts are dropped on read; removed by clearAllStorage() and clearAllProofDrafts().
entries.description: Non-secret proof wizard field values. Signatures, tokens and proof artifacts are never stored.

entries.retention: Kept until the user resets it.
entries.cleanup: Invalid values resolve to the default locale on read; removed when the user resets the preference.
entries.description: Chosen locale string.

entries.retention: Kept until the user resets it.
entries.cleanup: Invalid values resolve to the default time zone on read; removed when the user resets the preference.
entries.description: Chosen IANA time zone.

entries.retention: Kept until the user switches organization or signs out.
entries.cleanup: clearStoredOrganizationId() on organization removal.
entries.description: Id of the organization the UI is scoped to. An id only, no organization data.

entries.retention: 5 minutes (CAPABILITY_CACHE_TTL_MS).
entries.cleanup: Discarded on TTL expiry, malformed data, or a deployment identity change.
entries.description: UX-only copy of the server capability document. Never an authorization source.

entries.retention: Kept as a local audit trail until browser data is cleared.
entries.cleanup: Invalid shapes are discarded on read.
entries.description: Completed wallet rotation records (public addresses and timestamps).

entries.retention: Kept until browser data is cleared; stand-in until a backend inventory exists.
entries.cleanup: Invalid shapes are discarded on read.
entries.description: Client-local supported asset inventory.

entries.retention: Kept per account until the user deletes the source.
entries.cleanup: Invalid shapes are discarded on read; per-account key so another account never sees it.
entries.description: Trusted payment sources. user-scoped by account id.

entries.retention: Revoked entries are listed for a short window, then dropped.
entries.cleanup: Invalid shapes are discarded on read. Holds device metadata only, never bearer tokens.
entries.description: Listing of the account's active and recently revoked sessions. user-scoped by account id.

entries.retention: Kept per account until browser data is cleared.
entries.cleanup: Invalid shapes are discarded on read.
entries.description: Invoice reference to payment bindings. user-scoped by account id.

entries.retention: Each proof carries expiresAt; kept per account.
entries.cleanup: Invalid shapes are discarded on read.
entries.description: Invoice settlement proof records. user-scoped by account id.

entries.retention: Each link carries expiresAt; revoked links stay listed.
entries.cleanup: Invalid shapes are discarded on read. Only a digest of the share token is stored, never the token.
entries.description: Share link records (digest, expiry, disclosure choices). user-scoped by account id.

allowedFields.name: token
allowedFields.reason: createShareLink returns the raw token to the caller once; only tokenHash is written to storage.

entries.retention: Kept per account until browser data is cleared.
entries.cleanup: Invalid shapes are discarded on read.
entries.description: Payment backfill job records. user-scoped by account id.

entries.retention: Each proof carries expiresAt; kept per account.
entries.cleanup: Invalid shapes are discarded on read.
entries.description: Employment continuity proof records. user-scoped by account id.

entries.retention: Kept per account until browser data is cleared.
entries.cleanup: Invalid shapes are discarded on read.
entries.description: Predecessor and successor proof links. user-scoped by account id.

entries.retention: Each export carries expiresAt (EXPORT_RETENTION_DAYS).
entries.cleanup: Invalid shapes are discarded on read.
entries.description: Organization export request records. user-scoped by account id.

entries.retention: One ISO timestamp per account; the freshness window is enforced by the reader.
entries.cleanup: Overwritten on each re-authentication. Holds a timestamp only, never a credential.
entries.description: Time of the last re-authentication used to gate archival actions. user-scoped by account id.

entries.retention: Cached operations are refreshed from the server; kept until cleared.
entries.cleanup: clearOperations(); invalid shapes are discarded on read.
entries.description: Cached approval queue for recovery after refresh. Scoped to account and organization.

retired.reason: Bearer tokens are held in memory only (issue #305). The old entry is deleted on sight and never trusted.
